bin/lark-cli.content:
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$FAKE_LARK_LOG"
case "$1 $2" in
  "docs +update")
    case " $* " in
      *" --doc https://example.invalid/redacted "*)
        cat > "$FAKE_TRACE_CONTENT"
        ;;
      *)
        cat > /dev/null
        ;;
    esac
    printf '%s\n' '{"ok":true}'
    ;;
  "whoami --as")
    printf '%s\n' '{"identity":"bot","available":true,"tokenStatus":"ready"}'
    ;;
  "base +record-list")
    printf '%s\n' '{"ok":true,"data":{"items":[]}}'
    ;;
  "base +record-upsert")
    printf '%s\n' '{"ok":true,"data":{"record":{"record_id":"rec_contract"}}}'
    ;;
	  "base +record-get")
	    field_id=""
	    previous=""
	    for arg in "$@"; do
	      if [ "$previous" = "--field-id" ]; then field_id="$arg"; break; fi
	      previous="$arg"
	    done
	    printf '{"ok":true,"data":{"record":{"record_id":"rec_contract","fields":{"%s":"docx:TraceDocument"}}}}\n' "$field_id"
    ;;
  *)
    printf '%s\n' "unexpected command: $*" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
